column1: # Storage write-ownership manifest — the reviewed registry behind scripts/check-write-owners.sh.
# One row per (variable, file) pairing that writes a shared storage-base variable, across the
# game facade, the storage base and the modules. OWNER rows name the role and, for multi-writer
# variables, how the writers coordinate; HELPER rows are the storage base's own mutators; INIT
# rows are constructor / deploy-only. Two rows are label collisions with a local variable
# (`boonPacked`), kept so the registry stays in exact correspondence with the extractor.
